title: Model↔Runtime Interlock and Rollback Safeguards
creator: Asha Patel
description: Goal: Implement a robust interlock and rollback system that enforces safe model/runtime pairings, orchestrates progressive rollouts across LTS and edge channels, and provides automatic fallbacks when compatibility or SLO violations are detected. This ticket covers the policy design, runtime-side handshake extension, routing controller changes, console controls for pinning/unpinning, and emergency rollback automation. We must avoid a tight coupling that blocks fast model upgrades while guaranteeing that mismatched binaries or quantization variants do not reach production traffic.
acceptance_criteria: Define a well-documented compatibility policy DSL that operators can use to declare allowed model↔runtime pairings and fallback chains
Runtime handshake extension implemented: agent reports runtime semver, supported model ABI tags, and quantization capabilities during routing decision
Routing controller enforces the policy and can execute staged rollouts with canary -> ramp -> global steps using configurable SLO gates
Automatic fallback behavior: if canary fails health/SLO thresholds, traffic shifts to the prior compatible model/runtime without data loss and with <5s failover median
Console UI: pin/unpin controls for customer tenants, visual view of current pairings, and audit log entries for all changes
End-to-end tests: unit + integration tests covering handshake, mismatch detection, fallback, and rollback scenarios
Runbook created and reviewed by SRE, with one simulated cross-region rollback rehearsal completed
updates: 2026-02-15: Ticket created by Asha to capture interlock and rollback requirements after incident INC-2026-02-03 where runtime-model mismatch caused degraded outputs.
2026-02-20: Design sync with Runtime, Routing, and Console teams. Decided on lightweight compatibility tags (abi:v1, q8_0, q4_1) plus semantic runtime version reporting.
2026-02-27: Prototype handshake implemented on runtime side (PR: github.com/redwood/realtime/pull/1427). Runtime now exposes 'supported_model_tags' in the /v1/hello response.
2026-03-04: Routing controller MVP updated to consult compatibility DSL stored in config service. Canary rollout engine added (feature-flag gated).
2026-03-09: Integration test failing for quantized model fallback path — root cause: cache key mismatch when switching runtime binaries. Created follow-up ENG-25162.
2026-03-12: Emergency rollback automation spec drafted and reviewed. SRE requested additional telemetry hooks (latency p50/p90/p99, error_rate, hallucination_signals) before enabling auto-fallback.
2026-03-12: Security review kickoff scheduled with Compliance for KMS audit logging on pin/unpin actions (security_review_required=true).
notes: Trade-offs considered: strict semver gating vs tag-based capability gating. We chose capability tags to allow rapid model upgrades when runtimes are backward-compatible at the ABI layer.

Operational policy: default behavior for new model uploads is 'opt-in' for runtime channels older than the model's min_runtime_version. Console will surface a one-click compatibility check before enabling traffic.
Rollback strategy: prefer model rollback over runtime rollback when possible (cheaper and faster), but fallback to runtime rollback if model variant not available in registry.
Open question: whether we should allow temporary 'compatibility shims' for limited traffic — flagged for product discussion in next PM sync.
